title: Agentic AI for High-Volume Recruitment
summary: An agentic AI that screens 1,000-2,000 CVs a month, runs the government certificate check, and folds in IQ and personality results - cutting screening time from weeks to days.
problem: A high-volume recruitment client processes 1,000-2,000 CVs every month, and every hire has to clear a government-mandated certificate check before moving forward. Done by hand, that check alone took roughly 20 minutes per candidate - before IQ and personality testing even started, stretching total screening to 2-3 weeks.
solution: We built an agentic AI that takes over the pipeline the moment a candidate applies: it reads the submitted data, runs the government certificate check, pulls in IQ and personality test results, and produces a single structured score the hiring team can act on immediately.
outcome: Screening that used to take 2-3 weeks now finishes in 3-4 days, without loosening the compliance checks the process exists to enforce.

title: AI Sales Nurturing
summary: A daily agentic audit of every open sales slip for a US enterprise on SAP, so a promised purchase order never quietly ages past its date.
problem: A US enterprise running SAP across thousands of records had sales slips falling through the cracks - deals where a client had promised a purchase order for a specific month, but no one caught it when that month arrived. The Director of Sales didn't have the hours in the week to audit every open slip by hand.
solution: We deployed an agentic AI that runs a daily audit of every open sales slip, cross-checks promised PO dates, and sends the sales team a daily reminder the moment a follow-up is due.
outcome: Follow-ups that used to depend on someone remembering now happen automatically, every day, across the full pipeline.

title: Agentic AI for Relationship & Investment Managers
summary: A digital twin of a private banker's decision-making, matching Fixed Coupon Note positions to each client's real risk appetite.
problem: A private banker managing Fixed Coupon Note (FCN) portfolios needed to keep every client's exposure to a single stock within their real risk appetite - a judgment call that used to live entirely in the banker's head.
solution: We built a digital twin of the banker's decision-making: a dashboard that reads each client's appetite, flags when an FCN position pushes a client toward over-exposure to one stock, and curates new investment opportunities that fit their risk profile.
outcome: The banker now gets an appetite-matched shortlist and an over-exposure alert instead of holding every client's risk tolerance in memory.

title: Agentic AI for Hospitality & Concierge
summary: Not a chatbot - an agentic concierge that recommends restaurants, activities, and things to do around the property.
problem: Hotel guests expect a concierge who actually knows the neighborhood, not a chatbot that answers in circles about check-out time.
solution: We built an agentic concierge that recommends restaurants, things to do, and places to visit around the property, drawing on real local knowledge instead of a generic FAQ script.
outcome: Guests get concierge-level recommendations on demand, without waiting on front-desk availability.

title: AI CMO
summary: A continuous agentic marketing analyst that keeps strategy on-trend and feeds findings into SEO and AI-search visibility.
problem: Marketing 5.0 turned attention into a war, and most marketing directors don't have the bandwidth to track global trends, run market research, and execute a directed strategy all at once.
solution: We built an agentic AI that runs continuous marketing analysis and market research, then feeds the findings into a directed digital strategy - publishing into both SEO and the AI systems (like ChatGPT) that increasingly shape buyer discovery.
outcome: Strategy stops being a quarterly deck and becomes a standing, on-trend process that keeps pace with the market instead of catching up to it.

metric.label: Market research and strategy, replacing ad-hoc reviews
